description: Helicity-barrier numbers quoted from the retired 2025 README and manuscript. This file contains no ACE or Parker Solar Probe measurements.
provenance: Rewritten 2026-10-19. The 2025-12-16 version attributed these numbers to Squire et al. 2022 and McIntyre et al. 2025 and listed PSP encounters with invented beta ranges and barrier-detection flags; those were removed.

variables.Delta_zeta_4: zeta_4 - 2 zeta_2, intermittency deviation of magnetic structure-function exponents

constitutive_law.source: 2025 manuscript section 12.4 and Appendix C (history/2025/body.original.txt on main)
constitutive_law.data_described_by_source: ACE magnetic field 1998-2011, 64 s cadence, about 3.2 million intervals after cuts
consistency_notes: For a two-regressor fit, R2 = 0.82 with df = 156 implies F of about 355, not 247.3.
The polynomial is negative for 1.007 < C_B < 8.32, so it applies only for C_B below about 1.
